title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Live resources greyed out as dead
summary: The usage count beside every resource key read 4000 of a project's 6278 files, with no guard for the ones it never opened. A key used only in those files read 0 usages and was greyed out as dead.

highlights.title: 419 to 756 false zeroes
highlights.description: Measured on a real project of 2007 badged keys: 130 really are unused. The rest changed with the order the files came back in.

highlights.title: A question mark past the ceiling
highlights.description: The count now reads the whole project, and past the ceiling it shows ? usages and greys nothing, as the dependency badge already did.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The resource usage badge read only the first 4000 source files and had no truncation guard, so a key used beyond them was called dead.
The reverse string map, which lists the screens a string appears on, read the same 4000 files and now sees them all.
